title: Double arrows DOWN when BGs are going UP !!
body:
Very strange. The BGs (coming from xDrip) are going up, the numbers are going up in AAPS too but AAPS shows double DOWN arrows ???

Logs are attached. The times are on the screen captures.

![Screenshot_20230602_203522_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/67489cd4-0c93-4637-b312-789d3ced6d6f)

comments.body:
log starts 16:29
but generaly aaps displays arrow received from BG source

Yes, that's what I thought but xDrip (the source) gave the correct arrow...

Restarting the phone solved the problem.

Hi @MilosKozak 

Got bitten by the double down arrows once more. It might be related to very jumpy BGs and the smoothing algorithm.

You have the times from the screenshots.

![Screenshot_20230705_102055_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/57aa3e8f-6f30-495d-aaa1-501203664dfe)

As before, very strangely, force stop AAPS, clear cache memory doesn't solve the problem.

Restarting phone does solve the problem.

I wonder what's the difference between _force stop and clear cache_ vs _restart phone_... Maybe a lock on a file that is reset at reboot. 🤔

Once again, I have the double arrows for no reason.
I'm using at the moment xDrip and xDrip variant1 at the same time (end of one sensor and the new one "heating up" for 48h). xDrip variant1 doesn't send any data nowhere. I wonder if for some reason this could be the cause... The last time I reported it, it was 13 days ago, probably I had double xDrip running too. xDrip variant has been running for 23 hours and double arrows happened just now.

![Screenshot_20230718_081403_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/a8e43812-7be2-4ba8-8371-6e248fbfd92b)

I'm using at the moment xDrip and xDrip variant1 at the same time (end of one sensor and the new one "heating up" for 48h). xDrip variant1 doesn't send any data nowhere. I wonder if for some reason this could be the cause...

 EDIT : It is NOT related to having 2 xDrip/G6 running at the same time. I have only 1 G6 at the moment and have the double arrows (only in AAPS with smoothing). Might help, this sensor is very sensitive to pressure and declaires lows when I sleep on it and goes to normal when I change positions.

![Screenshot_20230725_021812_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/4c852e55-b37a-42e9-8e3a-a704d871ad60)
